preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p_list) and all(0 <= c_i <= n-1 for c_i in c_list)
preconditions.description: Each vertex has a parent p_i (0 for root) and a count c_i of vertices in its subtree with a_j < a_i, where 0 ≤ p_i ≤ n and 0 ≤ c_i ≤ n-1.
The input lists p_list and c_list each contain exactly n elements corresponding to the vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Vertex indices are 0-based in the input lists but correspond to 1-based numbering in the problem statement.

postconditions.description: If a valid assignment of a_i values exists, output 'YES' followed by the list of a_i values (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9). Otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a_list) if solution_exists else True
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, all a_i values must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i == sum(1 for j in subtree(i) if a_j < a_i) for i in range(n)) if solution_exists else True
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, the computed c_i must match the number of vertices j in its subtree where a_j < a_i.
